name: lib/compress
description: DEFLATE/zlib primitives (inflate + deflate, buffers, stream readers/writers) and gzip. Container formats (ZIP) live in std/archive.
residual: MoveToFront, BWHCompressor and OZip3 entered 2026-08-24, unclaimed until then: the Burrows-Wheeler family and a file-compression command over the primitives already here.

Moved out of std/ 2026-08-27 by the Rust border (docs/STDLIB.md): the standard library holds what packages talk to each other through; this is a leaf that ob get can deliver. Sources still live in source/ -- only the classification moved. `headless` false keeps it out of the SDK payload.
